call_sites: reckon/crew_dispatch_commands.py:1589 _queue_dispatch_batch from the crew dispatch --batch branch

findings.text: non-blocking: the assertion compares the stored backend against CONFIG["local_backend"], and the fixture sets default_backend to that same name at line 31, so a regression that ignored the entry's local choice and took the default lane leaves the assertion green; setting default_backend to a different backend would make it fail when the local choice is dropped.

non-blocking: when the entry sets local and the configuration declares no local_backend, the guard skips to the default lane and the entry stores local false, where a single dispatch's --local raises FlightConfigError at reckon/flight.py:2352; a batch entry asking for the local lane is quietly given a different one.

non-blocking: a second duration parser still matches a single integer-and-unit run, so a request storing "1h30m" now reaches _declared_budget_verdict at reckon/calibration.py:143 and falls through with budget_seconds None, and a run that overran its compound budget is judged as having none rather than as duration_over_budget.
